name: benchmark-coverage-remaining-findings
title: Benchmark coverage for the remaining structural findings (F2-F8)
description: Close the measurement gaps that make the remaining structural findings of 09-29-tcp-udp-path-structural-perf (F2 locks/scaling, F3 sweeps, F4 keys/parsing, F5 pump I/O, F6 UDP residency, F8 pump-thread attribution) unfalsifiable: contention/multi-pump rows, a flow-table sweep-pause probe with a zero-allocation gate, a TCP new-flow churn scenario with tail latency, a proxy data-path micro, pump idle/wake rows, a live-residency census, and the fake-collaborator distortions that zero out the deltas.
creator: qmazon
